summary: Tested Phase 1 Quick Fixes: Expense Entry amount field width, Franchise Dashboard connectivity card, and MIS Working Capital center-wise API. Backend APIs working correctly. UI changes verified.

integration_issues.issue: Card shows 'Vacant' even for PB-PERTH which has franchise mapped. The FranchiseOwnerDashboard.jsx fetches franchise list from /masters/franchises/list and looks for f.center === center, but franchise records don't have a 'center' field. The MIS Working Capital API correctly maps centers to franchises via center_franchise_map, but the dashboard uses a different API.

expense_entry_amount_width.details: Amount input field has min-w-[140px] (actual width 287px). Column header has w-36 (144px). Both verified via Playwright.

franchise_connectivity_card_ui.details: Card renders correctly with data-testid='franchise-connectivity-card'. Shows amber styling with 'Vacant' badge when no franchise mapped. Green styling with owner name when connected (UI code verified).

franchise_connectivity_data_fetch.details: Card always shows 'Vacant' because franchise records don't have 'center' field. The code looks for f.center === center but franchises have city/country, not center code.

mis_working_capital_all_centers.details: POST /api/mis/working-capital with center=all returns all centers with WC data. Returns initial_working_capital, total_loans, total_repaid, available_working_capital, centers array.

mis_working_capital_specific_center.details: POST /api/mis/working-capital with center=PB-PERTH returns WC=900000 initial, 870000 available (after 50K loan, 20K repaid).

mis_working_capital_unmapped_center.details: POST /api/mis/working-capital with center=PB-KHARADI returns 0 values (no franchise mapped).

action_items: Fix FranchiseOwnerDashboard.jsx franchise data fetching - franchises don't have 'center' field. Either: (1) Add center field to franchise records, or (2) Use centers_mapped array from franchise, or (3) Use the center_franchise_map logic from mis_dashboard.py working-capital endpoint
critical_code_review_comments: FranchiseOwnerDashboard.jsx line 87: const myFranchise = (frRes.data.items || []).find(f => f.center === center) - franchise records don't have 'center' field, they have 'city' and 'country'
The MIS Working Capital API (mis_dashboard.py lines 787-797) correctly builds center_franchise_map using franchise.center and centers_mapped array - this logic should be reused for the dashboard

success_rate.frontend: 90% (UI changes verified, data fetch issue found)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 Quick Fixes tested. Expense Entry amount width is correct (min-w-[140px]). MIS Working Capital API works correctly for center-wise filtering. Franchise connectivity card UI is implemented but shows 'Vacant' for all centers because franchise records don't have 'center' field - needs data model fix.
